systems.title: Session and service composition
systems.summary: Main/F5 instances the existing 3D scene; its shared base controller creates one scene-owned session for rear and battlefield views. BaseSimulation injects the same rear/ledger into domain services. The development opening has four real present unloaders at the south Table service apron.

nodes.label: Build service graph and shared ledger

systems.notes: Configured main.tscn is a root instance of preview.tscn, whose script extends common main.gd. No extra wrapper/controller, autoload or game session is introduced. F6 on either entry also uses 3D. Review scenes may create separate diagnostic sessions. Native input, the complete loop and FPS remain unverified; stages 1/2 await player acceptance.

systems.title: Time, deadlines and settlement
systems.summary: The actual implementation still advances one shared rear time across rear and battlefield services. Live wall-time debt and cooperative route planning feed an event-boundary loop.

nodes.label: Physics callback (at most once per rendered frame in live mode)
Choose nearest service deadline and advance

systems.notes: advance_time queries next_boundary across services, advances work/motion and calls _settle. _settle has a 1000-iteration safety bound; it is not a thousand unconditional passes. Finite event-woken logistics processing is a separate path. Independent domain clocks/timer-only overhaul is NOT completed.

systems.title: Identity, custody, stock and claims
systems.summary: One ledger owns physical people, hulls, stock portions, weapons, holders, ownership, fuel, health and reservations. Services request validated mutations; detached inspections are read models.

nodes.label: Move an actual entity / emit position events

systems.notes: inspect_entity is a query, not the game-loop controller. Many callers share the ledger because goods/people must retain identity across systems. Broad snapshots, narrow queries and mutation APIs coexist; this atlas does not measure their frequency. Explicit activity-owned per-person handling points permit real port arrival without widening global interaction distances. Actual person-held round release emits person_fired for read-only presentation.

systems.title: People: civilian workers and infantry
systems.summary: There are not two independent civilian/infantry entity implementations. The same PERSON identity has assignment, qualification, duty, holder, gear, health, morale and suppression. Different services own its activities.

nodes.label: Shared Person record and Assignment enum

systems.notes: Arrows show possible lifecycle stages, not automatic enlistment. Workers, instructors, crew, passengers and infantry have distinct eligibility/commitment rules. The player manager is a separate ManagerPose/CharacterBody3D, not a free worker identity.

systems.title: Staffing, reporting and priorities
systems.summary: Requested staff, assignment and physical presence are separate. Shared people are rebalanced by duties/priorities and walk/report before contributing work. Development service eligibility includes the apron outside the unchanged construction rectangle. Empty-field people reserve distinct physical service positions through RearWorkPositions; read-only route admission and actual commitment use the same point owner.

nodes.label: Validate actual person and service-strip eligibility
Choose reachable distinct physical work point

systems.notes: One person cannot fill two jobs at once. Newly completed facilities apply their starting request through Construction once; selecting or changing a recipe must not reset deliberate edits. Work points avoid Table/building geometry, preserve person identity and register explicit per-person handling access. Legacy unregistered handling keeps exact colocation. Reservations are not visual offsets or a universal crowd solver. In the empty-field game uncommitted people default to fallback Hauling after workplace/crew quotas. Shared starter-candidate rules preserve once-only automatic workplace demand; safe Reporting completion retries. Actual outbound tasks retain exclusive worker ownership until completion.

systems.title: Storage, hauling and space promises
systems.owner: RearSimulation jobs / actors / stores + ledger claims
systems.summary: Haul requests reserve real source portions and destination capacity. Actor phases represent walking, pickup, carrying and deposit; output space and relocation promises belong to the rear. The default common pool selects its next feasible category in an explicitly confirmed top-first order through existing service owners.
systems.notes: This diagram is the local rear haul path. Strategic manifests, forward trucks and frontline issue have other owners. Construction utility trucks can replace a local long carry leg without creating resources. HaulingPolicy owns preference only. Incoming unloading retains four shared/dedicated slots per berth; ordinary Dispatch retains manifest/route/custody/finite task and real transport/driver. Active safe work is not cancelled by reorder. Ledger-composed two-person timber custody is a current standalone capability; supplier/ordinary paired route connection and measured shelf contacts remain pending.

systems.summary: Receiving owns actual paid resource/worker purchases and physical supplier movement, berth/loading capacity and custody. Development Confirm atomically registers and immediately dispatches one convoy; the final actual handover/departure event reopens ordering while empty egress continues.

Record actual departure and drain member set

systems.notes: Resources and people are parallel order types, not mandatory sequential steps. Empty-field Supply Table has its own configured receiving arrangement; a Receiving Bay is not required for the first worker purchase. Credit from controlled resource objectives goes to this account. Empty-field workers use reserved actual pickup/drop/arrival points and retain original handling durations/cargo claims. Actual arriving foot positions survive admission instead of collapsing onto the Table centre. Incoming handling accepts idle common haulers through the existing owner; common entries retire after deposit and do not bypass the next category selection. Combined actual jobs retain four slots per berth and25kg carries.

systems.title: Rear building placement, completion and dismantling
systems.summary: ConstructionService owns actual sites, access, partial local-material-supported earned work and incremental consumption. Persistent scene adapters reveal the building; finite scissors/tape/pylons celebrate actual completion without owning capability.
systems.notes: Cancellation and request_dismantle are separate branches with consumed-material/clearance rules. An incomplete/paused/cancelled site does not become a free functional building. Same manager occupation validation is supplied by the 3D view. Empty-field placement validation starts at the shared Table standing-access point, preserving the solid Table and rejecting blocked routes without starting inside its collider. Live cancellation keeps exact site/session/state validation and refreshes actual material loss while builders continue; it is not invalidated by consumption alone. Normal live empty-field startup is1x. Shared licensed prototype exteriors cover buildable kinds; Vehicle Park remains open ground. Presentation listens to keyed owner signals, preserves meshes/colliders across work updates and tears down with site/session lifetime. Follow-up: assigned starved builders may fetch only their own site M11 on foot through existing real claims/carries; one duty/task, no simultaneous construction. Selected menu distinguishes actual haul receipt/carry. Completed exterior retains full-height prepared material, work state does not rebuild unchanged reservations, zero-alpha effect preparation targets measured first-use OpenGL hitch. Smoke1.5s then snip2s, tape release3.5s; actual capability remains immediate. A one-draw startup loading cover prepares actual construction variants in the real camera before input; shared appearance recipe has no gameplay row/stock/physics, and headless entry skips rendering preparation.

systems.title: Automatic factory input and army shipping
systems.summary: Session commits and genuine HQ/frontline need wake finite passes. It requests missing factory hauls and advances automatic delivery requests through existing owners.

nodes.label: Committed session change wakes finite pass
Process one candidate per frame, then idle
Ask activity for actual missing input demand

systems.notes: _process is enabled only while finite candidates remain; there is no idle logistics polling timer. This does not make the entire game event-only: the shared clock and scheduled army reviews still run.

functions.name: _enter_tree
functions.purpose: Reconnect sources and invalidate an already-built panel when it re-enters the scene tree.

functions.name: _ready
functions.purpose: Build persistent supply overview, followable-recipient selector, contextual actions and physical-stage/request containers with UIKit, then bind visibility and current source notifications for one deferred initial read.

functions.name: bind
functions.purpose: Disconnect the prior binding, advance callback generation, retain weak current-session and reader references, clear stale presentation/actions, reconnect when in-tree and request one visible read.

functions.name: _current_session
functions.purpose: Resolve the weak session reference only while its Node remains valid, returning null after destruction.

functions.name: _connect_sources
functions.purpose: Subscribe to the current session's committed state/replacement signals and current logistics intent changes without timers or elapsed-time polling.

functions.name: _connect_signal
functions.purpose: Connect an available source signal once and record weak-source callback metadata for safe later disconnection.

functions.name: _disconnect_sources
functions.purpose: Disconnect every still-live recorded source/callback pair and clear the subscription inventory.

functions.name: _on_simulation_changed
functions.purpose: Invalidate queued work with a new generation, disconnect old sources, clear old rows/actions, bind current owners and schedule fresh visible presentation after simulation replacement.

functions.name: _on_visibility_changed
functions.purpose: Mark supply presentation dirty when visibility changes so a shown panel reads current facts while a hidden panel retains no repeated reads.

functions.name: _invalidate
functions.purpose: Mark the panel dirty and schedule at most one generation-bound deferred refresh when built, visible, in-tree and bound to a valid current reader/session.

functions.name: _refresh
functions.purpose: Ignore obsolete callbacks, resolve the current visible binding and read once when dirty; reject replacement during the read, clear invalid results and render the detached current view.

functions.name: _clear_current_view
functions.purpose: Discard stale view, actions and recipient selection, disable retained buttons and hide old physical/request rows while showing an honest waiting state.

functions.name: _render_view
functions.purpose: Update current overview, explicit hold, readable blockers, recipients, actions and separate physical/request sections using retained controls.

functions.name: _sync_recipients
functions.purpose: Update recipient options and detached rows by stable identity, retain a still-valid selection, clear a removed selection and avoid emitting selection callbacks during refresh.

functions.name: _on_recipient_selected
functions.purpose: Accept a valid current recipient choice, update its detail and observe-action availability without reading or commanding the simulation.

functions.name: _render_recipient
functions.purpose: Show the selected followed person's current carried, reported need, committed and remaining ammunition with optional authoritative named-cycle receipt and operation detail; preserve the selection prompt when no row is selected.

functions.name: _sync_actions
functions.purpose: Reuse semantic-action buttons, update labels/order/style and current definitions, hide obsolete actions and compute availability without rebuilding controls or moving focus.

functions.name: _update_action_availability
functions.purpose: Enable only current permitted actions from a clean view, requiring a valid selected recipient for observation.

functions.name: _current_action
functions.purpose: Resolve one semantic action from the current detached view rather than a stale button closure.

functions.name: _activate_action
functions.purpose: Reject dirty, hidden, detached or invalid-reader clicks, copy the current enabled action, attach a valid selected observation identity and emit intent for the lead-owned controller.

functions.name: _sync_stages
functions.purpose: Reuse indexed stage containers to display current labels, quantities and explanations, hiding surplus rows without implying a causal shipment lineage.

functions.name: _sync_requests
functions.purpose: Reuse request rows by stable request ID and show actual state, cancellation, HQ receipts and blockers separately; hide absent rows and present an empty state.

functions.name: _set_text
functions.purpose: Change a retained Label only when its displayed text differs.

functions.name: _exit_tree
functions.purpose: Disconnect scene-owned subscriptions, invalidate deferred callbacks and clear stale actions/presentation when leaving the tree.

functions.name: view
functions.purpose: Preserve actual ammunition/forward recipient projection and add distinct HQ rifle equipment need/local issue/physical rear receipt context plus E01 cancellation-hold/resume action. Never portray ammunition resume or STOCK couriers as frontline weapon replacement.

functions.name: _supply_feedback
functions.purpose: Return fresh presentation-only current-stage feedback from supplied aggregate need, available stock, committed HQ-forward freight and rear-hold facts. Distinguish no need, courier/local issue and existing HQ/forward/available-rear coverage. When shown coverage is incomplete, explicitly omit reserved/onboard rear-to-HQ cargo and require checking actual shipments before extra production; never assert a confirmed manufacture quantity, query owners, mutate gameplay or infer operational success.

functions.name: _munitions_site
functions.purpose: Choose a detached surviving munitions site for contextual navigation, preferring a completed site over unfinished construction without altering facility selection or production state.

functions.name: _init
functions.purpose: Retain a weak session reference, connect committed/model-replacement events and start with no idle per-frame processing.

functions.name: shipment_types
functions.purpose: List purchasable materials and supported non-heavy recipe output types for finite physical HQ delivery requests.

functions.name: _model
functions.purpose: Read the currently owned simulation through the weak session reference, returning null after its lifecycle ends.

functions.name: _replace_model
functions.purpose: Disconnect prior need sources and reset per-model request intent; bind current HQ E01 owner alongside unchanged OpeningResupply ammunition owner, publish fresh HQ need and wake only existing finite passes.

functions.name: _wake
functions.purpose: Wake finite factory and shipment passes on existing committed session events; restart only candidate visits-left so newly refuelled trucks are revisited, retaining cursor and conditional failed-input bookmarks without idle polling.

functions.name: _process
functions.purpose: Examine one rotating facility or delivery candidate per rendered frame, submit at most one physical command and drain the event-triggered pass to idle.

functions.name: _supply_factory
functions.purpose: Read actual current factory work-eligible input demand and submit at most one missing ingredient haul through the existing source/physical owner, carrying the actual factory identity for atomic provenance without changing manual requests or production eligibility.

functions.name: _source_inventory
functions.purpose: Retain existing accessible unreserved source accounting and input-store exclusions; E01 availability counts only actual empty functional unpromised weapon identities, with no generic STOCK rifle quantity.

functions.name: _ensure_haul
functions.purpose: Deduct existing destination/type promises from current missing inputs, choose actual available stock through existing source rules, and pass the optional actual factory to request_haul so automatic provenance precedes internal selection; preserve ordinary manual/other quantities and changed notifications.

functions.name: request_delivery
functions.purpose: Queue a validated explicit manual delivery request through the common request owner, preserving the player chosen quantity and releasing that type automatic cancellation hold.

functions.name: supply_intent
functions.purpose: Expose a detached type-specific cancellation hold and automatic request identity, keeping player intent separate from mutable request rows and physical custody.

functions.name: resume_automatic_supply
functions.purpose: Preserve explicit type-specific hold/cancelled-record semantics; resume invalidates the correct current source owner, including HQ for E01, without reviving cancelled work or clearing another supply hold.

functions.name: _invalidate_need
functions.purpose: Route E01 receipt/terminal/player-intent invalidation to matching current HQ identity and other types to matching current OpeningResupply, preserving replaced-model guards.

functions.name: _weapon_available
functions.purpose: Keep other shipment type behavior; actual E01 availability requires an owned functional empty physical WEAPON in accessible rear storage and no existing dispatch weapon promise.

functions.name: _queue_delivery
functions.purpose: Preserve manual/automatic request IDs, player holds and existing physical delivery intent; a manual update invalidates its current type owner without mutating an automatic or accepted cargo target.

functions.name: _uncredited_hq_receipt
functions.purpose: Read the nonnegative actual manifest HQ-unloaded amount not yet in this request credited high-water mark, without changing receipt, stock or demand; subtract it from outstanding promises already included in source coverage.

functions.name: ensure_army_supply
functions.purpose: Reconcile the current automatic request against fresh military need, other promises, uncredited HQ receipts and protected accepted cargo; preserve holds/manual intent, retire covered uncommitted work and its derived candidate state, or wake remaining work.

functions.name: cancel_request
functions.purpose: Record explicit player cancellation/hold for a live request, discard only its derived candidate bookmarks/pass state, and delegate unsent physical manifest cancellation while departed freight retains its actual trip rules.

functions.name: _set_status
functions.purpose: Publish delivery status only when its state or explanatory blocker actually changes.

functions.name: _advance_request
functions.purpose: Reconcile one actual Army-supply request and its protected shipment progress, requiring available goods, usable centre and real transport/driver; explain when no idle dedicated or common handler can prepare its next load.

functions.name: _clear_delivery_candidates
functions.purpose: Discard only a request own failed-fuel input bookmarks, finite visits-left and cursor when that derived candidate state is no longer needed.

systems.title: Military organization, equipment and readiness
systems.summary: Companies/platoons/squads, demands, crew reports and replacement reports reference real equipped people and attached hulls. Readiness derives from physical facts.
systems.notes: Civilian-to-military duties are ledger assignment/receipt changes, not replacement with a new Infantry object. Autonomous organization is not player RTS soldier-command UI.

functions.name: request_troop_trip
functions.purpose: Return troop_transport.request_trip(hull_id,squad_ids,board_place_id,dismount_place_id,outbound_points,return_points) for organization. Implementation: calls troop_transport.request_trip.

functions.name: request_reposition
functions.purpose: Return troop_transport.request_reposition(hull_id,destination_place_id,route_points,fallback_points) for organization. Implementation: calls troop_transport.request_reposition.

functions.name: interrupt_troop_trip
functions.purpose: Return troop_transport.interrupt_trip(id) for organization. Implementation: calls troop_transport.interrupt_trip.

functions.name: resume_troop_trip
functions.purpose: Return troop_transport.resume_trip(id,route_points) for organization. Implementation: calls troop_transport.resume_trip.

functions.name: hull_committed
functions.purpose: Return troop_transport.hull_committed(id) for organization. Implementation: calls troop_transport.hull_committed.

functions.name: person_committed
functions.purpose: Return troop_transport.person_committed(id) for organization. Implementation: calls troop_transport.person_committed.

functions.name: add_initial_squad
functions.purpose: Add initial squad for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref, id.is_empty, company_id.is_empty, platoon_id.is_empty; updates companies[company_id], platoons[platoon_id], rear.dispatch.military_people[person_id], seen[person_id].

functions.name: request_need
functions.purpose: Request need for organization. Implementation: calls reason.is_empty, _fail, _rear_ref.get_ref; updates _need_sequence, demands[id].

functions.name: assess_squad
functions.purpose: Assess squad for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref, _fail, people.size, int; updates specialist_count, unique[id].

functions.name: form_squad
functions.purpose: Form squad for organization. Implementation: calls assess_squad, _rear_ref.get_ref, _available_platoon, parent.is_empty; updates _sequence, artillery, squads[id], status.

functions.name: cancel_pending_squad
functions.purpose: Cancel pending squad for organization. Implementation: calls squads.get, row.is_empty, _fail, _rear_ref.get_ref; updates status.

functions.name: cancel_replacement
functions.purpose: Cancel replacement for organization. Implementation: calls replacement_reports.get, report.is_empty, _fail, _rear_ref.get_ref().ledger.inspect_entity(person_id).get.

functions.name: cancel_crew_report
functions.purpose: Cancel crew report for organization. Implementation: calls crew_reports.get, report.is_empty, _fail, _rear_ref.get_ref().ledger.inspect_entity(person_id).get.

functions.name: next_boundary
functions.purpose: Return the next scheduled organization event time for the shared scheduler. Implementation: calls troop_transport.next_boundary, squads.values, minf, float; updates next.

functions.name: advance_to
functions.purpose: Advance scheduled organization work to the supplied simulation time. Implementation: calls troop_transport.advance_to.

functions.name: record_death
functions.purpose: Record death for organization. Implementation: calls squads.values, row.roster.erase, _rear_ref.get_ref().ledger.clear_formation_appointment, _rear_ref.get_ref; updates row.blocker, row.leader, row.replacement_attempted, row.replacement_due.

functions.name: settle
functions.purpose: Complete due physical replacement/crew/formation reports, equip waiting formations, preserve the five-second lost-leader replacement boundary using a narrow living-duty check, then run existing replacement, organization, issue, vehicle and commander automation in order.

functions.name: _sync_commander
functions.purpose: Skip work when the current commander is alive using a narrow read; otherwise choose a living trained successor, transfer appointments and refill subordinate leadership without creating or moving a person.

functions.name: request_replacement
functions.purpose: Request replacement for organization. Implementation: calls squads.get, _rear_ref.get_ref, row.is_empty, row.vehicle.is_empty; updates pending, replacement_reports[person_id].

functions.name: _auto_replace
functions.purpose: Auto replace for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref, rear.dispatch.hq_reserve.keys, ids.sort, squads.values.

functions.name: _replacement_ready
functions.purpose: Replacement ready for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref().ledger.inspect_entity, _rear_ref.get_ref, person.is_empty, _rifle_ready.

functions.name: _auto_vehicle
functions.purpose: Visit admitted hulls deterministically, reject ineligible HQ hulls before inspection, attach driven hulls to available formations and schedule qualified reserve crew reports for unoccupied/unpromised stations.

functions.name: assign_crew
functions.purpose: Assign crew for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref, rear.dispatch.military_people.has, rear.dispatch.hq_reserve.get, rear.dispatch.military_hulls.has; updates crew_reports[person_id].

functions.name: attach_vehicle
functions.purpose: Return _attach_vehicle(hull_id,parent_id,true) for organization. Implementation: calls _attach_vehicle.

functions.name: attach_initial_vehicle
functions.purpose: Attach initial vehicle for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref, _fail, _attach_vehicle.

functions.name: _attach_vehicle
functions.purpose: Attach vehicle for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref, rear.ledger.inspect_entity, vehicles.has, rear.dispatch.military_hulls.has; updates vehicles[hull_id].

functions.name: set_vehicle_mission
functions.purpose: Set vehicle mission for organization, applying its validation and side effects. Implementation: calls vehicles.has, is_finite, _fail, _rear_ref.get_ref().ledger.inspect_entity; updates vehicles[hull_id].ammo_target, vehicles[hull_id].route_fuel.

functions.name: vehicle_supply_needs
functions.purpose: Vehicle supply needs for organization. Implementation: calls vehicles.has, _fail, hull_snapshot.is_empty, _rear_ref.get_ref().ledger.inspect_entity; updates ammo_urgent, ammunition[type].

functions.name: vehicle_readiness
functions.purpose: Compute existing crew, health, ammunition-target and route-fuel readiness from fresh hull metadata and living station predicates, omitting unused recursive carried mass.

functions.name: vehicle_capability
functions.purpose: Validate actual attached hull, qualified living driver and purpose-specific movement fuel, mounted gunner/ammunition or physically boarded passengers using fresh metadata and the original eligibility rules.

functions.name: _living_crew_id
functions.purpose: Living crew id for organization. Implementation: calls hull.is_empty, hull.has, hull.crew_by_station.has, _rear_ref.get_ref().ledger.inspect_person_status.

functions.name: board_squad
functions.purpose: Board squad for organization. Implementation: calls squads.get, _rear_ref.get_ref, rear.ledger.inspect_entity, row.is_empty.

functions.name: exit_squad
functions.purpose: Exit squad for organization. Implementation: calls squads.get, row.is_empty, row.vehicle.is_empty, _fail.

functions.name: _reserve_transport_manifest
functions.purpose: Validate distinct active owned unboarded squads and actual passenger-seat limits using current hull metadata, then reserve those squad places on the same attached hull without changing physical passenger custody.

functions.name: _release_transport_squad
functions.purpose: Release transport squad for organization. Implementation: calls vehicles.has, squads.has, _vehicle_squads, existing.erase; updates squads[squad_id].vehicle, vehicles[hull_id].passenger_squad, vehicles[hull_id].passenger_squads.

functions.name: _vehicle_squads
functions.purpose: Vehicle squads for organization. Implementation: calls vehicles.has, row.get("passenger_squads",[]).duplicate, row.get, result.is_empty.

functions.name: _all_reported
functions.purpose: All reported for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref().ledger.inspect_entity, _rear_ref.get_ref.

functions.name: _has_reporting
functions.purpose: Check whether reporting holds for organization. Implementation: calls squads.values.

functions.name: _artillery_sources
functions.purpose: Artillery sources for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref, rear.ledger.snapshot, artillery_guns.has, gun.is_empty; updates gun, needed.

functions.name: _reserve_artillery
functions.purpose: Reserve artillery for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref, _artillery_sources, sources.gun.is_empty, claims.size; updates artillery_guns[sources.gun].

functions.name: _equip_artillery
functions.purpose: Equip artillery for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref, rear.ledger.inspect_entity, gun.is_empty, rear.ledger.move_field_gun; updates row.blocker.

functions.name: _prune_empty_parent
functions.purpose: Prune empty parent for organization. Implementation: calls platoons.has, platoon.squads.is_empty, platoon.vehicles.is_empty, companies[company_id].platoons.erase.

functions.name: _available_platoon
functions.purpose: Available platoon for organization. Implementation: calls platoons[id].get, _rear_ref.get_ref, platoons[id].squads.size, _owned_count; updates companies[company_id], company_id, company_serial, platoon_id.

functions.name: _appoint_squad
functions.purpose: Appoint squad for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref, rear.ledger.inspect_entity, rear.ledger.set_formation_appointment, row.leader.is_empty; updates row.acting, row.blocker, row.leader, row.replacement_attempted.

functions.name: _appoint_seniors
functions.purpose: Appoint seniors for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref, rear.ledger.inspect_entity(_commander_id).get, rear.ledger.inspect_entity, squads.values; updates row.blocker, row.leader, used[_commander_id], used[leader].

functions.name: _auto_organize
functions.purpose: Auto organize for organization. Implementation: calls demands.values, ordered.append, ordered.sort_custom, ordered.is_empty; updates status.

functions.name: _candidate_people
functions.purpose: Inspect and select people eligible for automatic formation organization.

functions.name: _auto_issue_for_need
functions.purpose: Auto issue for need for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref, demands.values, ordered.append, ordered.sort_custom; updates generic_guards, requested, status.

functions.name: _need_before
functions.purpose: Need before for organization.

functions.name: _immediate_rifle_need
functions.purpose: Immediate rifle need for organization. Implementation: calls demands.values, int.

functions.name: _issue_weapon
functions.purpose: Issue weapon for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref, rear.ledger.snapshot, rear.hq.weapon_promises.has, rear.hq.request_person_weapon.

functions.name: _issue_plan
functions.purpose: Issue plan for organization.

functions.name: _package
functions.purpose: Package for organization. Implementation: calls people.size, int, _fail, _rear_ref.get_ref; updates count, equipment[type], required.

functions.name: _artillery_count
functions.purpose: Artillery count for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref, squad_id.is_empty, _artillery_sources, sources.gun.is_empty; updates total.

functions.purpose: Return _rear_ref.get_ref().ledger.physical_quantity_at(id,type,["WEAPON","STOCK","HEAVY_OBJECT"]) for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref().ledger.physical_quantity_at, _rear_ref.get_ref.

functions.name: _held_any

functions.name: _rounds
functions.purpose: Return _rear_ref.get_ref().ledger.ammunition_quantity_at(id,"E02",["E01","E05","E19"]) for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref().ledger.ammunition_quantity_at, _rear_ref.get_ref.

functions.name: personal_round_counts
functions.purpose: Read current personal loose and loaded E02 quantities for the selected roster in one ledger query using the same E01/E05/E19 physical-count rules as the scalar military ammunition helper.

functions.name: _rounds_any
functions.purpose: Return total for organization. Implementation: calls _rounds; updates total.

functions.name: _at_berth
functions.purpose: Return total for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref().ledger.snapshot, _rear_ref.get_ref; updates total.

functions.name: snapshot
functions.purpose: Export the current organization state as a detached inspection dictionary. Implementation: calls squads.values, owner.is_empty, row.get, _rear_ref.get_ref; updates copy.readiness.

functions.name: shortages
functions.purpose: Shortages for organization. Implementation: calls owner.is_empty, _rear_ref.get_ref, demands.values, assess_squad.

functions.name: readiness
functions.purpose: Readiness for organization. Implementation: calls squads.get, row.is_empty, _active_roster_members, _desired_equipment; updates ammunition, amount, equipment.

functions.name: capability
functions.purpose: Capability for organization. Implementation: calls _fail, squads.get, row.is_empty, row.vehicle.is_empty.

functions.name: rifle_can_fight
functions.purpose: Rifle can fight for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref, ledger.entities_at, rear.combat.reloads.get, reload.is_empty.

functions.name: _active_roster_members
functions.purpose: Delegate current roster eligibility to the ledger and return the same ordered living formation-member IDs with the caller-selected matching-carrier policy, without detailed person exports.

functions.name: _desired_equipment
functions.purpose: Desired equipment for organization.

functions.name: _roster_specialists
functions.purpose: Return result for organization. Implementation: calls str, SPECIALISTS[row.kind].keys, _rear_ref.get_ref().ledger.inspect_entity, _rear_ref.get_ref.

functions.name: commander
functions.purpose: Commander for organization. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref, rear.ledger.inspect_person_status, appointed.is_empty, original.is_empty.

functions.name: audit
functions.purpose: Audit for organization. Implementation: calls troop_transport.audit, _rear_ref.get_ref, _owned_count, errors.append; updates seen[id], senior_seen[row.leader].

functions.name: _fail
functions.purpose: Return a failed organization command result with the supplied explanation.

functions.name: _owned_count
functions.purpose: Return count for organization. Implementation: calls rows.values, row.get, _rear_ref.get_ref; updates count.

systems.title: Military passenger and supply transport
systems.summary: Named trips reserve real people/hull/stations/seats and plan bounded routes. Boarding, travel, interruption and dismount preserve current intent and custody.
systems.notes: Reposition and supply-trip methods are additional guarded paths. This owner is different from rear Dispatch and HQ-to-forward freight.

functions.name: _init
functions.purpose: Initialize troop transport state and retain its supplied dependencies. Implementation: calls weakref, rear.ledger.inspect_entity("troop-transit").is_empty, rear.ledger.inspect_entity, rear.ledger.add_place; updates _organization_ref, _rear_ref.

systems.title: Squad and vehicle action execution
systems.summary: Delivered intent drives foot movement, cover, combat and resupply decisions. Pending route/decision work is separated from authoritative commits.
systems.notes: Decision scheduling still includes recurring simulation-time reviews. This is not a per-person _process script and is not proof of stable60FPS.

functions.name: has_due_decisions
functions.purpose: Report whether retained due squad-decision events still await live execution.

functions.name: decision_backlog
functions.purpose: Expose retained decision count and oldest logical-time age for liveness acceptance; this read neither executes nor removes work.

functions.name: has_planning_work
functions.purpose: Report pending due squad decisions or private foot-route preparations for the live work owner.

functions.name: cancel_planning
functions.purpose: Discard this session owner's due decision queue and unadmitted foot preparations, retaining already admitted physical motions.

functions.name: invalidate_planning
functions.purpose: Discard captured work for pending foot routes so fresh geometry can be prepared; retain due decisions and existing physical motions.

functions.name: pump_planning
functions.purpose: Execute at most one due current squad decision when running, or step one private foot route within the supplied allowance. Recheck current person, order, load, safety and terrain before admitting motion; paused preparation never moves a person.

functions.purpose: Initialize squad execution state and retain its supplied dependencies. Implementation: calls weakref, Vehicles.new, SupplyTravel.new; updates _rear_ref, next_decision, supply_travel, vehicle_execution.

functions.name: _init/<lambda#1>
functions.purpose: Provide an inline callback that returns execution._authorize_supply_transport(proposal,allow_issue) if execution != null else {"ok":false,"message":"The originating session is unavailable."}.

functions.purpose: Return _rear_ref.get_ref() for squad execution. Implementation: calls _rear_ref.get_ref.

functions.purpose: Return the next scheduled squad execution event time for the shared scheduler. Implementation: calls minf, vehicle_execution.next_boundary, motions.values, float; updates boundary.

functions.purpose: Return motions.has(id) for squad execution. Implementation: calls motions.has.

functions.name: advance_to
functions.purpose: Advance admitted foot motions with current custody, task, terrain, safety and ammunition checks; pending routes cannot move. Batch actual ammunition once for admitted armed motions within this synchronous position-only update.

functions.name: settle
functions.purpose: Resolve unavailable motion and mounted departures, retain every eligible due squad decision in live mode or execute synchronously for explicit callers, and keep the existing one-second policy boundary and optional inclusive timing.

functions.purpose: Clear unavailable motions for squad execution. Implementation: calls motions.keys, _rear().ledger.inspect_person_status, _rear, _supply_motion_valid; updates changed.

functions.name: _execute
functions.purpose: Execute one current acknowledged squad intent with the existing capability, collection, survival, fire, care and movement rules; batch initial fresh ammunition counts while retaining later authoritative checks and optional substep timing. Record one last pickup diagnostic from the already-evaluated context, threat and final withdrawal facts without another gate evaluation or settlement.

functions.name: _execute/<lambda#1>
functions.purpose: Provide an inline callback that returns job.operator == id.

functions.name: _collection_owner
functions.purpose: Return policy.squad_supply_owner() if policy != null and policy.has_method("squad_supply_owner") else null for squad execution. Implementation: calls policy.squad_supply_owner, policy.has_method.

functions.name: _authorize_supply_transport
functions.purpose: Authorize supply transport for squad execution. Implementation: calls policy.has_method, policy.authorize_supply_transport.

functions.name: _collection_context
functions.purpose: Evaluate the existing Rifle, defence, supply-owner, current-parent, rendezvous, urgency-or-continuation and capability gates in their original short-circuit order; annotate the caller-owned local diagnostic with the actual first blocking reason. No extra capability read or decision is added.

functions.name: _record_collection_check
functions.purpose: Replace the existing execution owner's single latest scalar diagnostic for an own Rifle squad with the assessed time, current intent/parent/owner identities and a past-tense pickup reason. This metadata starts no work and stores no history.

functions.name: collection_readiness

systems.title: Main menus, rear controls and guidance
systems.summary: The mounted base_demo.gd is the real main management UI despite its filename. Button commands use service owners; retained panels refresh through session commits/time with visibility guards. Combined purchases and staffing use explicit confirmation; model refresh preserves current unconfirmed staffing drafts and model/context replacement invalidates them. Existing-site inspection opens Build controls without acquiring a new blueprint; acquisition retains its separate explicit intent.

nodes.label: Open panel with explicit preview intent
Acquire a new blueprint only by construction intent

systems.notes: Hidden UI intentionally skips expensive refresh. This matters to selection:3D Workshop opens management before resolving current facility metadata. Existing scroll-heavy layout remains; generated diagrams do not establish enjoyable UI acceptance. Hauling has a composed inline disclosure with native grip drag/insertion line and keyboard/button fallback. Draft survives live status refresh; Confirm delegates once to Rear; central menu close discards unconfirmed changes.

systems.title: Battlefield read models and 2D inspection
systems.summary: Read models select permitted own units/observed contacts and objective facts. Inspection and supply-stage feedback use actual identities with existing information restrictions. Existing3D observation now has ID-keyed provisional friendly T03 and T04 hulls and distinct permitted report cues, shared picking/inspection and canonical deadline-driven report expiry. No duplicate simulation, hidden enemy bodies or approved-art/FPS claim. The explicitly authorized friendly forward stop has a shared selectable cue and read-only loose-stock/opening-issue inspection; bounded active delivery/issue states and latest confirmed transfer events are separate from current loose stock; full history and untracked interrupted rack work remain unavailable. An explicit follow action keeps one permitted friendly person in view and shows their own squad’s acknowledged intent separately from current activity. Selected friendly engagement facts distinguish own-squad task and status, individual motion/reload and current E02 from any same-recipient historical transfer.

functions.name: test_02c_hot_checks_avoid_full_entity_exports
functions.purpose: Measure one hundred repeated commander/vehicle/HQ checks in opening and completed HQ fixtures, enforce focused full-inspection bounds and save comparative costs without asserting fragile wall timings.

functions.name: test_02d_sight_candidates_preserve_real_contact_reports
functions.purpose: Compare narrow sight metadata and actual squad/APC sampling output against full snapshot inputs across four synthetic enemy assignments, including a positive enemy squad contact and friendly rejection.

functions.purpose: Run the opt-in live menu scene with shared 60 FPS defaults and configured observations/count budgets, await completion or captured failure, assert its world/physics are paused and reject any run that stopped before its coverage report.

functions.purpose: Inject a known 17 ms interval into the real action probe, assert the report fails and simulation pauses, and verify live failure logging independently of OS frame timing.

functions.name: test_00_seventeen_ms_frame_pauses_and_writes_failure/<lambda#1>
functions.purpose: Select the actual frame_time_budget issue from the expected rejection report.

functions.name: test_01_seventeen_ms_synchronous_action_pauses_and_writes_failure
functions.purpose: Finish a real probe action with known 17 ms synchronous work, assert failed acceptance and paused simulation, and verify the detailed failure artifact is written.

functions.name: test_01_seventeen_ms_synchronous_action_pauses_and_writes_failure/<lambda#1>
functions.purpose: Select the actual action_time_budget issue from the expected rejection report.

functions.name: test_02_larger_environment_limits_cannot_weaken_acceptance
functions.purpose: Attempt 100 ms environment limits for both frame and action paths and prove the same 17 ms work still fails and pauses the model.

functions.name: _violation
functions.purpose: Create an isolated real simulation/probe fixture at 1x, temporarily choose default or attempted override limits and a separate intentional-rejection directory, inject frame/action work, return its report/speed/artifact path, free nodes and restore the prior environment.

functions.name: test_00_all_buildable_kinds_and_rotations_have_detached_read_only_hints
functions.purpose: Check every buildable catalogue kind and orientation against full legal geometry on an empty-field fixture; mutate detached hint data and verify sites, ledger and logical time remain unchanged.

functions.name: test_01_fixed_nonfinite_and_edge_violations_remain_rejected
functions.purpose: Reject fixed/unknown kinds and nonfinite or out-of-bounds poses, and prove invalid authoritative placement creates no sites.

functions.name: test_02_cancelled_footprint_tracks_current_retained_stock_without_a_cache
functions.purpose: Place/cancel a real site and vary explicit retained material through ledger commands; prove fresh hints release empty cancelled footprints and retain occupied ones without stale cached geometry.

functions.name: test_03_hints_never_run_full_preview_or_route_searches
functions.purpose: Trace 128 real hint queries, prove none invokes full validation or route search, then verify explicit preview still calls the real path validator.

functions.name: test_04_provisional_success_never_authorizes_blocked_or_stale_placement
functions.purpose: Distinguish clear-footprint hints from protected arrival-lane access, reject their authoritative placement, and reject a formerly clear pose after a site is committed there.

functions.name: test_05_matched_populated_query_benchmark
functions.purpose: Prepare separate equivalent six-site fixtures, warm each query mode, disable counters only for alternating matched full-preview/hint CPU samples, restore instrumentation, verify unchanged authority/time and save three raw microsecond batches separately from live-frame evidence.

functions.name: _fixture

functions.purpose: Save the current window/diagnostic configuration, establish a focused native 1280 by 720 test window with embedded popups and attach the strict action/error probe.

functions.name: after_test
functions.purpose: Stop and remove the probe, return one frame and restore the saved window and diagnostic configuration.

functions.name: test_ordinary_primary_and_management_panels_keep_pace_at_one_x
functions.purpose: Open the ordinary persistent full-world game, start 1x through its speed control, navigate eleven primary/management destinations through real inputs and observe each for two seconds with unchanged frame/action, audit, progress, debt and AI backlog gates.

functions.purpose: Record the native PopupMenu item ID actually activated so the test requires exactly the requested management destination.

functions.purpose: Compare every fixed entrance pair and blocked centre against the original uncached Dijkstra route, check segment clearance, prove returned route arrays are detached and verify bounded memo eviction preserves route ordering.

functions.name: _legacy_path
functions.purpose: Run the retained original uncached fixed-template visibility graph and Dijkstra tie order as an independent route-array oracle, including empty routes for blocked endpoints.

functions.purpose: Create an inactive observation probe for component watchdog/error reporting, explicitly labelling synthetic stepping as separate from FPS evidence.

functions.name: after_test

functions.name: _advance

functions.name: test_empty_field_workers_and_purchased_inputs_reach_a_real_completed_batch
functions.purpose: In an explicit empty-field component, buy actual workers and materials, construct/staff a workshop and require one conserved completed batch to create a real empty E01 weapon, correct storage/output facts and exact ingredient haul quantities; save full failure state.

functions.name: test_intact_rifles_and_loaded_ammo_use_storage_capacity_without_becoming_loose_haul_stock
functions.purpose: Use a declared Receiving fixture and the actual reload operation to verify rifle plus loaded-round mass in scalar/batched reads, exclusion from loose hauling, atomic rejection of insufficient Receiving capacity, retained identities/rounds and a clean audit.

functions.name: test_two_requests_use_real_returning_transport_and_credit_unloading_once
functions.purpose: Complete two requests with the same real driven returning hull, verify one unloading credit per manifest, stock conservation and fuel use, then cancel a third actual departed trip and prove its real remaining freight offsets newly reopened demand without a duplicate automatic request or ledger mutation.

functions.name: test_manual_promises_and_cancellation_hold_preserve_explicit_request_quantities
functions.purpose: Verify manual promises offset automatic need, repeated need cannot duplicate requests, only automatic quantities grow, cancelling holds regeneration until explicit reopening, the source notification is invalidated, manual quantities remain fixed and session replacement clears old intent without mutating either ledger.

functions.name: test_ordinary_request_and_cancel_buttons_do_not_create_goods_or_vehicles
functions.purpose: Navigate the ordinary game using real viewport input, request and cancel finite HQ delivery metadata while paused, and verify unchanged physical ledger state.

functions.name: _press
functions.purpose: Reveal the actual scroll-contained button, inject a GUI click at its centre and allow real engine input/layout frames before checking the result.

functions.name: _click_at
functions.purpose: Inject actual viewport mouse motion and a left-button press/release pair at the requested GUI position.

functions.name: test_00_characterize_training_reads_without_hidden_owner_mutations
functions.purpose: Compare legacy and scoped Train display facts and raw owner state on independent equivalent fixtures across nine states, check repeated reads stabilize, audit both models and save bounded characterization.

functions.name: test_01_snapshot_normalization_is_characterized_before_purity_migration
functions.purpose: Inject a stale presentation reason into independent prepared worlds and require old/new reads to normalize raw training state identically; explicitly characterize the current read side effect.

functions.name: test_02_train_reads_are_detached_and_missing_selection_is_safe
functions.purpose: Mutate nested returned training/person/store data to prove detachment from authority, then verify missing selections are safe and subsequent reads retain valid progress.

functions.name: test_03_read_order_preserves_withdrawal_progress_and_no_ui_outcomes
functions.purpose: Drive equivalent observed and unobserved worlds through progress and withdrawal, requiring equal raw outcomes and no qualification granted to the withdrawn student.

functions.name: test_04_train_read_measurements
functions.purpose: Record 30 uncached Train read durations and diagnostic call deltas on a warmed prepared fixture, labelling elapsed-call timing separately from CPU self time.

functions.name: test_05_frozen_pre_change_training_states_and_display_values
functions.purpose: Preserve original frozen pre/post/display hashes through the separately reviewed seven-field idle-scheduler projection; also require full current raw-state query purity and optionally capture complete states for explicit characterization review.

functions.name: test_06_train_view_avoids_world_exports_and_domain_commands
functions.purpose: Require the implemented Train API, zero broad Base/rear/ledger exports and command entries, and correct active/paused counts plus selected-person facts on the prepared fixture.

functions.name: test_07_rejected_training_commands_explicitly_need_no_reconciliation
functions.purpose: Require rejected course/withdrawal commands to declare no reconciliation and preserve raw state, while accepted course/access commands retain reconciliation guarantees.

functions.name: test_08_selected_withdrawn_completed_injured_and_dead_students_match_legacy_reads
functions.purpose: Compare selected withdrawn, completed, injured and dead students on independent old/new read paths, preserving visible facts, stored script state and valid identity/status with passing domain audits.

functions.name: _difference
functions.purpose: Return positive per-function counter deltas between two diagnostic snapshots.

functions.name: _save
functions.purpose: Write JSON-safe training guard evidence to the configured log directory, asserting that its report file could be opened.

functions.name: test_worker_rows_prepare_across_frames_and_replacement_cancels_old_bindings
functions.purpose: Verify at most one worker control group appears per process frame, all eligible duties receive correct limits, preparation becomes idle, and replacing a session with queued old work cannot retain old controls or mutate either physical ledger.

systems.title: Optional review scenes, fixtures and probes
systems.summary: The repo retains subsystem demos/fixtures, a synthetic full-size probe and overhead evaluation. Many are available from optional Diagnostics; they are not evidence of ordinary gameplay completion.
systems.notes: base_demo is deliberately NOT classified here: it is mounted main UI. Optional scenes may instantiate independent simulations. Test files are listed under their subsystem in the source inventory, with retained-test classification; no test suite was executed.
